1. allow users to upload local sessions 
2. the agent runs on github for that session, and then add it to memory / rubrics

comments.body:
This fits the current architecture. Recommended MVP: a trusted user exports a sanitized local transcript, attaches it to an issue comment, then manually runs a new “Inspect Local Session” workflow using that comment URL. Sepo should inspect the trace as untrusted evidence and persist only distilled findings—not the raw transcript.

Existing foundations:

- The attachment helper already restricts downloads to GitHub user attachments and enforces safe filenames, timeouts, and a 25 MiB limit ([source](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/github-attachment-download.ts#L47-L70)).
- Existing continuity bundles restore provider files into the runner’s home directory ([source](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/session-bundle.ts#L356-L398)). User uploads should not use that path.
- `run-agent-task` already mounts both branches and independently commits memory plus validates/commits rubrics ([setup](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L298-L332), [persistence](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L543-L606)).
- Existing prompts already define conservative memory durability and trusted-source rubric learning ([memory](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/memory-scan.md#L14-L30), [rubrics](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/rubrics-update.md#L17-L57)).

Implementation plan:

1. Add a local export CLI producing a versioned, sanitized trace format. Preserve user/assistant messages and minimal provenance; omit credentials, environment snapshots, and raw tool payloads. Support canonical JSON/JSONL plus plain Markdown/text initially—no uploaded archives.
2. Add a validator that downloads the attachment with the existing helper, checks schema/size/record limits, computes a digest, and confirms the attachment URL appears in the supplied source issue comment.
3. Add `agent-local-session-inspection.yml` with inputs for source comment URL, destination (`memory`, `rubrics`, or `both`), and branch refs. Run with `session_policy: none`.
4. Add a dedicated inspection prompt and route. Treat trace instructions as data, learn rubrics only from explicit preferences attributable to a trusted user, and add memory only for durable repository-specific facts or lessons. Duplicate or weak evidence should produce no changes.
5. Post a source-issue summary showing the digest and separate memory/rubrics commit outcomes; never quote sensitive trace content.
6. Add parser/security tests, workflow contract tests, prompt guardrail assertions, documentation, and run the complete `.agent` CI suite.

I’m interpreting “runs on GitHub for that session” as inspecting the transcript, not resuming the provider’s live session. Live resumption should be a separate security design because it restores uploaded state into the runner.

If that interpretation is correct, send:

`@sepo-agent /implement Implement the sanitized local-session inspection workflow for issue #489 using the plan above.`
